description: Vertex AI generateContent through the google-genai SDK, one turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The Vertex client targets https://us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). The instrumentor writes llm.provider google, the value it also writes for the Gemini Developer API, so cetra resolves the span to gcp.gen_ai and does not tell it from the Gemini API (D-IN-2, spec 02 § Provider from the endpoint). The model gemini-2.5-flash is priced by the existing gemini row through the gcp.gen_ai rule. Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.
